purpose: Project bounded, default-deny, fresh-context role inputs and capabilities.
rules: Use a fresh context, workspace, tool session, and capability set for each role instance.
Mount candidate and fixtures read-only and expose no sibling arm, governance root, canonical root, or production credential.
Disable network unless a sealed campaign policy and broker permit an exact endpoint.
Apply explicit byte, token, output, reference-hop, and tool-result limits.
Overflow uses a typed continuation or hard failure and never silent truncation.
